title: Nível 2: ache o shiny
concept: Level 2 on mint paper: 7×10 lizards, a 50° hue-shifted shiny and two size decoys, a 5-second segmented timer with a halfway hint, the decoys get crossed out and a magnifier finds the shiny; then night falls ('E se ele aparecer às 3h da manhã?') and KizuBot answers with a real shiny alarm.
claims: alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp
detecção de shinys, megas e bosses
